messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing p99 spikes on prod GPU pool during long-context runs. KV cache memory keeps climbing past expected high-water marks, eviction attempts aren't reclaiming fast enough.
jamie: Any recent changes to evicter config or batching? link to dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/evict/4165
alex: Not on prod. We flipped a FIFO experiment in canary yesterday, forgot to revert on one shard?
maria: profiler dump (snippet):
```
evict_attempts=34 evicted=0 pager_queue_len=120 reclaim_wave_ms=320 host=gpux-13
kernel_select=amx_matmul_v2 batch_sz=16 kv_page_io=21
```
maria: also saw many reinserts: `reinserted=47` in the same interval.
evicter-bot: [alert] evicter_throttle engaged on gpux-13 :warning:
vikram: This smells like LRU reinsertion churn -> reuse counters get bumped but we still page because FIFO wins on order under sustained appends.
jamie: So LRU correctness vs FIFO reuse tradeoff again. Any concrete repro? can we reproduce with long-context loadgen? @maria
maria: Ran a 30m replay locally. Repro steps:
```
1) run loadgen --seq=8192 --qps=120 --model=redwood-7b
2) observe kv stats: evicting_rate<<insert_rate, pager backlog grows
3) enable stats: ./admin/kvdump --top=50
```
maria: sample kvdump line: `key=ctx-... size=1024 last_access=12s age=0.02 reuse=0` — lots of near-zero reuse but huge resident size.
alex: Observed latency delta: p50 2.1ms p95 12ms p99 180ms during the surge. Spikes align with reclaim waves.
vikram: Hypothesis: eviction batch ordering + reinserts are causing write amplification and temporary starvation of fast path. Atomic evict+reinsert path isn't batching well.
jamie: Ideas: 1) add adaptive-ageing (decay older entries' reuse score by coef) 2) add a short reinsert-hold window (de-dup reinserts within 50ms) 3) reduce evict_batch_max and make reclaim-waves more frequent but smaller
alex: I prototyped config patch: `evict_policy=hybrid_ageing`, `age_decay=0.65`, `reinsert_hold_ms=50`, `evict_batch_max=8`
maria: Ran the proto for 15m -- p99 dropped from 180ms -> 35ms, pager_queue_len flattened. No correctness regressions in our canary traces.
jamie: Nice. Any risks? correctness/ordering issues?
vikram: Need to be careful with hot-key atomicity when we hold reinserts. We'll add a quick correctness test that fuzzes concurrent evict/reinsert under high seq lengths.
alex: Plan: ship config toggle to dedicated canary shard for 2h tonight. If stable, roll to prod with a staged ramp. I'll add metrics: `evicter.reinserts_suppressed`, `evicter.age_decay_coef`, `evicter.evict_batch_size`
maria: I'll add the loadgen job and run longer 2h replay. I'll also capture heap-profile and kv-index snapshots.
evicter-bot: deploy: patch queued to canary cluster by alex — link: https://ci.redwood/evict/1234 :rocket:
alex: assigning: i'll own the rollout, @jamie please run the correctness fuzz and @maria please run 2h replay and capture traces. If p99 < 50ms and no data loss, promote.
jamie: On it. I'll post results in this thread.
